title: KAITO — The Feelings I've Watched Over〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO! We brought that wand over from the other room like you asked☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Where should we put it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much.
Then, please set it off to the side on that stage over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay♪
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Alright, thanks to everyone's help, this show seems to be coming along nicely. That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Heave... Ho...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just a little left to go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Just a little...bit...more...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Phew... We did it!
Thank you all very much for your help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO! Here's that panel for the backdrop you asked for!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Still, wasn't it heavy?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not at all! The plushies and I brought it over by working together! We chanted, “Heave ho!” the entire way!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah, that was really fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. Again, thank you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, that reminds me.
Do you know where Rin and Len are?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin and Len?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. They're supposed to be working on the costumes, but I haven't seen them for a little while.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I passed by the dressing room a second ago, but I don't remember seeing them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
Where could they have gone?
Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You gotta hear this! It's an emergency!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin? What happened? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, uhh!
It's just... Well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A new area just appeared in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A new area?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len and I were running back because we still had things left to do for this show...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And then we saw a place that we'd never seen before...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There was the sea, a ship and tons of plushies..

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And, uhh... I don't know how else to describe it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A-A-Anyway!
You guys gotta come! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, Rin...!
Don't pull like that! It's dangerous...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Over here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, this is amazing☆
I've never seen this place before!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It feels so alive.
I mean, just look at all the plushies...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now do you see what I was trying to say?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! I can't believe a new area sprang up in SEKAI like this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But why? What made it appear all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is just my guess...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it may have something to do with a change in Tsukasa's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In his feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from Tsukasa's feelings, so it would make sense that they were behind this new area appearing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. I can't say for sure what feelings went into this place, but...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Let's play over in that plaza.
I brought a ball we can use!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I'll see you at the beach a little later!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All the plushies here seem to be having quite a lot of fun. They have such big smiles on their faces.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
Which means this must be a very fun place to be!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And it seems safe for the most part...
We should probably tell Tsukasa and the others the news.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, me!
I wanna go tell them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! Me too☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe☆ I can't wait to see their faces when they see what's happened!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Their eyes might pop out of their heads.
Also, Tsukasa will probably shout, “What is this place?!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you're right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm looking forward to their arrival.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(This sea and port city...
And that big ship...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If this place was created by Tsukasa's feelings changing in some way...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (What were those feelings?)
